verdict.stance: Neutral / Low-Leverage Ukrainian Telco (0.9x) vs Feb-27 NBU FX Transfer Watch
verdict.summary: Vodafone Ukraine generates resilient ~50% OIBDA margins (UAH 14.0bn FY25) and holds a decade-high $262m cash against $294m net debt (0.9x LTM EBITDA). Credit focus centers entirely on the approaching February 11, 2027 ~$280m Eurobond maturity and NBU wartime cross-border FX transfer restrictions (preceded by the Feb-25 2-year extension).

positives: Low net leverage (0.9x LTM EBITDA at mid-2026) and decade-high $262m cash buffer (~28% hard currency).
Resilient ~50.4% OIBDA margin despite power backup capex and wartime disruptions.
Demonstrated willingness & ability to pay down $99.9m principal in Feb-25.
negatives: Feb 11, 2027 ~$280m Eurobond maturity is under 3 months away; NBU FX restrictions constrain cross-border principal outflows.
Wartime grid instability requires ongoing battery/generator capex and opex.
100% UAH revenue base exposed to hryvnia depreciation against USD bond service.

background.business_overview: Ukraine's #2 mobile telecom operator (~15m+ subscribers), owned by NEQSOL Holding.
background.asset_perimeter: 4G/LTE nationwide network, Vega fixed broadband, backup energy infrastructure.

recent_drivers: H126: Cash hit $262m (~28% FX), net debt $294m (0.9x LTM EBITDA); Q226 EBITDA $87m.
Nov-26: Feb 11, 2027 ~$280m bond maturity window imminent; bondholder consent/NBU exemption watched closely.
